title: SonarQube

environmentVariables.name: SONARQUBE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: User token generated in your SonarQube Server or Cloud account settings.

environmentVariables.name: SONARQUBE_ORG
environmentVariables.description: Required for SonarQube Cloud. Your organization key, found in SonarQube Cloud.

environmentVariables.name: SONARQUBE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Required for a self-managed SonarQube Server. For SonarQube Cloud US, use https://sonarqube.us.

envFields.label: SonarQube token
envFields.helperText: User token generated in your SonarQube Server or Cloud account settings.

envFields.label: Organization key (SonarQube Cloud)
envFields.helperText: Required for SonarQube Cloud. Your organization key, found in SonarQube Cloud.

envFields.label: Server URL (SonarQube Server)
envFields.helperText: Required for a self-managed SonarQube Server. For SonarQube Cloud US, use https://sonarqube.us.

dev.openhands.installHint: SONARQUBE_TOKEN is always required. For SonarQube Cloud, set your organization key in SONARQUBE_ORG. For a self-managed SonarQube Server, set SONARQUBE_URL to your server URL; for SonarQube Cloud US, set SONARQUBE_URL to https://sonarqube.us. Requires a container runtime such as Docker.
dev.openhands.notes: Uses SonarSource's official SonarQube MCP Server, run locally as a Docker container. Provide a SonarQube user token. Set SONARQUBE_ORG for SonarQube Cloud, or SONARQUBE_URL for a self-managed SonarQube Server (or https://sonarqube.us for SonarQube Cloud US).
dev.openhands.originalDescription: Inspect code quality and security findings, quality gates, and analyze code snippets from SonarQube Server or Cloud.
